name: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme
benefit: - A stipend of ₹10,000/- per month. - The Lokpal of India gives a certificate to the interns completing the internship successfully. - The Lokpal of India provides working space, internet, and other appropriate facilities to the interns.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an institution affiliated with a recognized university within India. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a regular undergraduate or postgraduate degree course in the field of law, political science, public administration, public policy, management, economics, or human rights. 1. The applicant must have secured at least 75% or equivalent marks in the 12th class.1. The undergraduate student must have completed at least two years of study in the undergraduate course. 1. The undergraduate student must have a minimum aggregate of % or equivalent marks in years completed till the date of application. 1. The postgraduate students must have a minimum aggregate of 55% or equivalent in the graduation course. 1. The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship.
